title: Core standard front end (StandardMarkusProjector, projection.json, feeds, SEO, sitemap, listings, hooks)

comments.author: home
comments.text: Core standard front end is shipped and carrying 14 live sites: StandardMarkusProjector with projection.json, feeds (RSS+Atom), sitemap with lastmod, robots, 404, canonical/OG/Twitter/JSON-LD, listings/pagination/tags, forms, page blocks and islands, family footer, Markdown twins, llms.txt/llms-full.txt, Accept negotiation function, page actions. Verified by curl 2026-10-21 on pilobol.us, pr.ospect.us, aurit.us, kanb.us, apricity.anth.us, p.apyr.us, distinctive-mark.com, threat-intelligence.anth.us, read.p.apyr.us, chattic.us, tactus.anth.us, cyclotron.anth.us, anth.us. Documented in docs/building-a-papyrus-static-site.md and on p.apyr.us/standard-front-end.html. Follow-up core items from migrations merged in PR #464.
